description: Per-position conservation of the structurally defined E2-binding face in LONRF1 RING1 vs RING2 across vertebrate orthologs
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
pd.set_option("display.width",330); pd.set_option("display.max_rows",200)

def up_search(q, size=500):
    out=[]; url="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
    params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,organism_name,length,sequence,gene_names,lineage","format":"json","size":size}
    while url:
        r=requests.get(url,params=params,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status()
        out+=r.json()["results"]; params=None; url=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if len(out)>1200: break
    return out

RING = re.compile(r"(?=(C).{2}(C).{9,39}(C)G(H).{2}(C).{2}(C).{3,48}(C).{2}(C))")
def rings(seq):
    out=[]
    for m in RING.finditer(seq):
        lig=[m.start(i)+1 for i in range(1,9)]
        if not any(abs(lig[0]-o[0])<10 for o in out): out.append(lig)
    return out

res=up_search("(gene:LONRF1) AND taxonomy_id:7742 AND (fragment:false)")
# structural offsets derived from the RNF4/BIRC7/CBL E2 interfaces
OFF=[("L1+1",0,1),("L1+2",0,2),("L2+1",1,1),("L6",5,0),("L6+3",5,3),("L6+4",5,4),
     ("L6+7",5,7),("L7+1",6,1),("L7+2",6,2),("L8+1(linchpin)",7,1)]
prof={"RING1":{k:[] for k,_,_ in OFF},"RING2":{k:[] for k,_,_ in OFF}}
species=set(); nsp={"RING1":0,"RING2":0}
for e in res:
    org=e["organism"]["scientificName"]; seq=e["sequence"]["value"]; L=len(seq)
    gn=[g.get("geneName",{}).get("value","") for g in e.get("genes",[])]
    if gn and not any((g or "").upper().startswith("LONRF1") for g in gn): continue
    if org in species: continue
    species.add(org)
    rr=rings(seq)
    for tag,sel in [("RING1",[x for x in rr if x[0]/L<0.40]),("RING2",[x for x in rr if x[0]/L>=0.50])]:
        if not sel: continue
        lig=sel[0] if tag=="RING1" else sel[-1]
        nsp[tag]+=1
        for k,li,off in OFF:
            p=lig[li]+off
            prof[tag][k].append(seq[p-1] if p<=L else "-")

HUM={"RING1":[123,126,138,140,143,146,155,158],"RING2":[479,482,494,496,499,502,513,516]}
hs=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q17RB8.json",timeout=90).json()["sequence"]["value"]
RNF4=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P78317.json",timeout=90).json()["sequence"]["value"]
RLIG=[132,135,154,156,159,162,173,176]   # RNF4 ligands, UniProt numbering (= PDB numbering - 4)

rows=[]
for k,li,off in OFF:
    r4=RLIG[li]+off
    row=dict(position=k, RNF4=f"{RNF4[r4-1]}{r4}")
    for tag in ["RING1","RING2"]:
        hp=HUM[tag][li]+off
        c=Counter(prof[tag][k]); tot=sum(c.values()); top,n=c.most_common(1)[0]
        row[f"human_{tag}"]=f"{hs[hp-1]}{hp}"
        row[f"{tag}_consensus"]=f"{top} {100*n/tot:.0f}%"
        row[f"{tag}_entropy"]=round(float(-sum((v/tot)*np.log2(v/tot) for v in c.values())),2)
    rows.append(row)
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(f"Vertebrate LONRF1 orthologs analysed: RING1 n={nsp['RING1']}, RING2 n={nsp['RING2']} species")
print("\nConservation at the structurally defined E2-binding face (offsets from the zinc ligands)")
print(tab[["position","RNF4","human_RING1","RING1_consensus","RING1_entropy","human_RING2","RING2_consensus","RING2_entropy"]].to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nMean Shannon entropy  RING1 = {tab.RING1_entropy.mean():.2f} bits   RING2 = {tab.RING2_entropy.mean():.2f} bits")
from scipy.stats import wilcoxon
w=wilcoxon(tab.RING1_entropy, tab.RING2_entropy)
print(f"Wilcoxon signed-rank (RING1 vs RING2 entropy, n=10 positions): statistic={w.statistic}, p={w.pvalue:.4f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
x=np.arange(len(OFF)); w_=0.38
axes[0].bar(x-w_/2, tab.RING1_entropy, w_, label="LONRF1 RING1 (N-terminal)", color="#c44e52")
axes[0].bar(x+w_/2, tab.RING2_entropy, w_, label="LONRF1 RING2 (pre-Lon)", color="#4c72b0")
axes[0].set_xticks(x); axes[0].set_xticklabels(tab.position, rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_ylabel("Shannon entropy (bits)")
axes[0].set_title(f"E2-face conservation across vertebrate LONRF1 orthologs\n(RING1 n={nsp['RING1']}, RING2 n={nsp['RING2']} species)", fontsize=10)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8); axes[0].grid(axis="y", alpha=.3)

lbl=[f"{r.position}\nRNF4 {r.RNF4}" for _,r in tab.iterrows()]
m1=[f"{r.human_RING1}\n{r.RING1_consensus}" for _,r in tab.iterrows()]
m2=[f"{r.human_RING2}\n{r.RING2_consensus}" for _,r in tab.iterrows()]
axes[1].axis("off")
tb=axes[1].table(cellText=list(zip(m1,m2)), rowLabels=lbl, colLabels=["RING1","RING2"], loc="center", cellLoc="center")
tb.auto_set_font_size(False); tb.set_fontsize(7); tb.scale(1,1.9)
axes[1].set_title("Human residue / vertebrate consensus at each E2-contact position", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
